**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menghitung semua pasangan yang mungkin dengan memilih satu unsur dari masing-masing dua himpunan, tanpa melewatkan atau mengulang pasangan.

##### Menyelesaikan soal kelompok sama banyak

[equalGroups.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/groups/skills/equalGroups.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The total number of objects in equal groups is the number of groups multiplied by the size of each group. Any unknown one of the three related quantities can be obtained from the other two by the appropriate inverse operation when division is valid.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menyelesaikan soal kelompok sama besar dengan menghubungkan jumlah kelompok, isi tiap kelompok, dan total melalui perkalian atau pembagian.

#### Model masalah

Skills: 4

[models.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/models/models.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relationships between a concrete situation, drawing, schematic model, and numerical expression representing the required operation.

##### Memilih penjumlahan atau pengurangan

[chooseOperationAddSub.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/models/skills/chooseOperationAddSub.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The choice between addition and subtraction depends on the relationship between known and unknown quantities: combining, changing, comparing, or finding a part. The same wording in different problems does not always imply the same operation.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa memilih penjumlahan atau pengurangan dengan memahami hubungan besaran yang diketahui dan yang dicari, bukan hanya mengandalkan kata kunci.

##### Memilih perkalian atau pembagian

[chooseOperationMulDiv.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/models/skills/chooseOperationMulDiv.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Multiplication relates the number of equal groups, the size of each group, and their total; division finds an unknown component from the other two. The structure of equal groups determines the operation rather than a particular word in the problem.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menentukan kapan perlu mengalikan atau membagi dari jumlah kelompok sama besar, isi tiap kelompok, dan jumlah keseluruhan.

##### Membuat soal cerita dari model

[createProblem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/models/skills/createProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A constructed word problem must match the given mathematical model in its quantities, operations, known information, and unknowns. One expression can support several suitable story contexts, but each must preserve the underlying mathematical structure.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membuat soal cerita berdasarkan gambar, tabel, atau ekspresi matematika tanpa mengubah besaran dan hubungan matematikanya.

##### Memodelkan soal satu langkah

[oneStepModel.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/models/skills/oneStepModel.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A mathematical model must preserve the original problem's quantities, unknown, and relationships, regardless of whether it is a drawing, diagram, or expression. Using the correct numbers to represent a different relationship does not yield a valid model.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menyajikan soal cerita satu langkah dengan gambar, diagram, atau ekspresi yang tepat menggambarkan informasi yang diketahui dan yang dicari.

#### Soal bagian dan keseluruhan

Skills: 2

[parts.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/parts/parts.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relationships between a whole and its parts in contextual problems, including unit fractional parts.

##### Menentukan pecahan satuan dari jumlah

[fractionsContext.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/parts/skills/fractionsContext.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A unit fraction 1/n of a nonnegative quantity is obtained by dividing the whole into n equal parts for positive n. The situation must identify the chosen unit whole, and the selected part must be relative to that same whole.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa mencari pecahan satuan dari suatu besaran, seperti seperempat, dengan membagi keseluruhan menjadi bagian sama besar dan menentukan keseluruhan yang dimaksud.

##### Menyelesaikan soal bagian dan keseluruhan

[partWholeAddsub.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/parts/skills/partWholeAddsub.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When a whole consists of parts of 7 and 5, adding the parts reconstructs the whole; when the whole and one part are known, the other part is determined by subtraction.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menyelesaikan soal tentang keseluruhan dan bagian: menjumlahkan bagian yang diketahui untuk mendapat keseluruhan atau menguranginya untuk mencari bagian yang belum diketahui.

#### Perencanaan penyelesaian

Skills: 5

[planning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/planning/planning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Constructing and justifying a sequence of solution steps, checking units and answers, and considering alternative methods.

##### Menyusun soal kebalikan

[constructInverseProblem.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/planning/skills/constructInverseProblem.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Constructing an inverse word problem changes the roles of given and unknown quantities while preserving the mathematical relationship and allowing the original situation to be recovered. The competency is formulating a valid new situation and question; subsequently solving it assesses existing arithmetic and problem-solving skills, not a required part of this skill.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membuat soal cerita kebalikan dengan menukar peran besaran yang diketahui dan yang dicari, sambil menjaga hubungan matematika semula.

##### Memeriksa satuan dan kewajaran jawaban

[explainAnswerUnits.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/planning/skills/explainAnswerUnits.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A word-problem answer must name the requested quantity in consistent units and satisfy the constraints of its mathematical or real-world context. A bare number without a unit or a plausibility check may fail to answer the question.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menulis jawaban dengan satuan yang benar dan memeriksa apakah masuk akal dalam situasinya, bukan hanya menulis angka.

##### Membandingkan strategi penyelesaian

[multipleSolutionStrategies.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/planning/skills/multipleSolutionStrategies.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Different algorithms or models can reach the same correct answer. Comparing strategies requires mathematical validity, justification of each step, computational complexity, and the conditions under which each method applies.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membandingkan dua cara yang benar untuk menyelesaikan soal serta menjelaskan kapan masing-masing berlaku dan mana yang lebih efisien.

##### Menyelesaikan soal tiga langkah

[threeStepPlan.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/planning/skills/threeStepPlan.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A three-step solution successively determines intermediate results required to find the primary unknown. Every operation must follow from the problem's conditions and each result must retain its contextual meaning.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menyelesaikan soal dengan tiga langkah yang saling berkaitan, memakai hasil antara untuk memperoleh jawaban akhir yang masuk akal.

##### Merencanakan penyelesaian dua langkah

[twoStepPlan.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/planning/skills/twoStepPlan.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A two-step solution includes an intermediate quantity that must be found before the final answer. The order of steps follows dependencies between the given and unknown quantities, not simply the written order of operation signs.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa merencanakan solusi dua langkah dengan mencari besaran antara yang harus dihitung lebih dulu dan menjelaskan alasan urutannya.

#### Soal besaran

Skills: 3

[quantities.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/quantities/quantities.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Practical relationships among work rate, time, price, quantity, mass, capacity, and length.

##### Memodelkan soal pengukuran

[measurementContext.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/quantities/skills/measurementContext.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Modeling a word problem involving measured quantities requires identifying the physical quantity, its unit, and relationships between known and unknown values. Length, mass, capacity, and time are possible contexts rather than mandatory separate parts of this single skill; consistent units and dimensions determine model validity.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa mengubah soal cerita tentang panjang, massa, kapasitas, waktu, atau besaran terukur lain menjadi hubungan matematika dengan satuan yang konsisten.

##### Menghubungkan harga, jumlah, dan biaya

[priceQuantityCost.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/quantities/skills/priceQuantityCost.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** When unit price is constant, total cost is price multiplied by quantity. The model must distinguish price per unit from the monetary total, and recognize that different price-and-quantity pairs can give the same total.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menghubungkan harga per barang, jumlah barang, dan biaya total: jika harga satuan tetap, harga dikalikan jumlah menghasilkan total.

##### Menghubungkan laju kerja, waktu, dan hasil

[workRateTime.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/problemSolving/quantities/skills/workRateTime.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** At a constant work rate, the amount of completed work equals rate multiplied by elapsed time. Units must be consistent, and the formula does not directly model varying rates without an additional assumption or model.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menghubungkan laju kerja tetap, waktu yang berlalu, dan pekerjaan yang selesai: laju dikalikan waktu menghasilkan banyaknya pekerjaan jika lajunya tetap.

### Penalaran

Groups: 4 · Skills: 9

[reasoning.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/reasoning.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Justifying mathematical statements, finding counterexamples, drawing logical conclusions, checking solutions, and translating between representations.

#### Argumentasi matematika

Skills: 5

[argumentation.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/argumentation/argumentation.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Justifying conclusions from mathematical conditions, evaluating universal statements, and explaining the selected solution method.

##### Mengelompokkan benda atau bilangan menurut aturan dan menjelaskan alasannya

[classifyAndJustify.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/argumentation/skills/classifyAndJustify.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Only numbers divisible by three may belong to a specified group; membership must be justified by the mathematical classification rule, not by superficial similarities of notation.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa mengelompokkan benda atau bilangan menurut aturan yang jelas dan menjelaskan mengapa setiap unsur termasuk atau tidak termasuk.

##### Membedakan satu contoh dari aturan umum

[distinguishExampleRule.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/argumentation/skills/distinguishExampleRule.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A confirming instance does not establish a universal mathematical proposition. A general rule requires justification across the entire specified class, while one valid counterexample refutes it.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membedakan satu contoh dari aturan yang diklaim berlaku dalam semua keadaan. Satu contoh yang sesuai belum membuktikan aturan umum.

##### Menarik kesimpulan dari kondisi dan penalaran

[drawConclusion.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/argumentation/skills/drawConclusion.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A logical conclusion must follow from established premises and prior statements through valid inference rules. Necessary consequences must be distinguished from plausible guesses and conclusions based on insufficient conditions.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa memakai fakta yang diberikan untuk menarik kesimpulan yang pasti mengikutinya, bukan sekadar menebak.

##### Menjelaskan strategi perhitungan yang dipilih

[explainStrategy.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/argumentation/skills/explainStrategy.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A mathematical explanation must communicate the actual sequence of transformations and why they preserve the result or justify an approximation. Verbal, visual, and symbolic representations may differ but must express the same underlying reasoning.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menjelaskan langkah perhitungan atau perkiraan dan alasan langkah itu benar, lewat kata-kata, diagram, atau simbol matematika.

##### Menemukan contoh tandingan untuk membantah generalisasi yang salah

[findCounterexample.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/argumentation/skills/findCounterexample.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** One valid case satisfying the premises but contradicting the conclusion is enough to refute a universal mathematical claim. A true counterexample must be distinguished from an example that merely fails to support the claim.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membantah pernyataan tentang semua kasus dengan menemukan satu contoh yang memenuhi syarat tetapi membuat pernyataan itu salah.

#### Penalaran logis

Skills: 1

[logic.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/logic/logic.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Using given constraints to exclude impossible alternatives and identify the sole valid conclusion. Completing numerical patterns belongs to algebraic competencies, not to a separate skill in this group.

##### Mengeliminasi pilihan yang tidak mungkin dalam soal logika

[logicalElimination.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/logic/skills/logicalElimination.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** In a puzzle with three doors and constraints ruling out two choices, the remaining door is the only possible answer; logical exclusion determines it without guessing.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menyingkirkan pilihan yang mustahil berdasarkan syarat yang diberikan dan menemukan satu-satunya jawaban yang benar tanpa menebak.

#### Representasi matematika

Skills: 1

[representations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/representations/representations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Translating between concrete depictions, diagrams, verbal rules, and symbolic notation while preserving mathematical meaning.

##### Mengubah antara representasi konkret, diagram, verbal, dan simbolis

[multipleRepresentations.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/representations/skills/multipleRepresentations.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Physical models, diagrams, verbal descriptions, and symbolic expressions can encode the same mathematical relationship. A valid translation preserves quantities, the roles of values, and their relationships, not just the written numerals.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menyajikan hubungan matematika yang sama melalui benda, diagram, kata-kata, atau ekspresi matematika, tanpa mengubah besaran dan hubungan di antaranya.

#### Memeriksa penyelesaian

Skills: 2

[verification.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/verification/verification.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Critically comparing a calculated result with the problem conditions, identifying mistakes, and using independent methods of verification.

##### Menilai kewajaran jawaban berdasarkan konteks dan besarannya

[checkReasonableness.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/verification/skills/checkReasonableness.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** For 98 + 105, a result near 200 is reasonable in scale whereas 2000 is not, even without carrying out an exact calculation.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menilai apakah jawaban masuk akal sesuai situasi dan besarnya nilai, meski tanpa menghitung secara tepat.

##### Memeriksa perhitungan dengan metode lain

[verifyWithSecondMethod.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/reasoning/verification/skills/verifyWithSecondMethod.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A quotient can be checked by multiplication, and a sum by subtraction; using an independent verification strategy can expose an error.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa memeriksa perhitungan dengan cara lain, misalnya memakai perkalian untuk mengecek pembagian, agar kesalahan terlihat.

### Waktu

Groups: 3 · Skills: 13

[time.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/time.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Calendar cycles, ways to represent instants, and calculations of event durations, distinguishing a date, a clock reading, and an elapsed interval.

#### Kalender

Skills: 4

[calendar.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/calendar/calendar.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Navigating days, weeks, months, and years while accounting for varying month lengths and leap years.

##### Menghitung hari di antara dua tanggal

[calendarInterval.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/calendar/skills/calendarInterval.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The number of days between two dates is the duration of the interval, accounting for month lengths and calendar boundaries. Elapsed days must be distinguished from an inclusive count of the named calendar dates.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menghitung berapa hari berlalu antara dua tanggal dengan memperhatikan panjang tiap bulan, tanpa mencampurnya dengan hitungan yang mencakup kedua tanggal.

##### Mengurutkan bagian-bagian hari

[daySequence.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/calendar/skills/daySequence.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Parts of the day form a recurring cycle, but their everyday names and boundaries depend on context. The competency concerns their sequence and matching events to approximate periods, without assigning a fixed clock time to each label.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa mengurutkan pagi, siang, sore, dan malam serta menghubungkannya dengan kegiatan sehari-hari, sambil memahami bahwa batas waktunya dapat berubah.

##### Membedakan tahun biasa dan tahun kabisat

[leapYearDays.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/calendar/skills/leapYearDays.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The Gregorian calendar distinguishes ordinary years of 365 days from leap years of 366 days, with 29 days in February. Divisibility by four determines leap years except century years not divisible by 400; navigating a calendar also requires correct transitions between dates.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membedakan tahun biasa 365 hari dan tahun kabisat 366 hari, mengenali 29 Februari, dan menggunakan kalender dengan benar.

##### Mengenali hari, minggu, dan bulan dalam kalender

[weekMonthYear.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/calendar/skills/weekMonthYear.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A week is a recurring sequence of seven days, while a calendar year consists of months of different lengths. The competency covers ordering days and months, locating dates, and handling transitions between weeks, months, and years.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa mencari tanggal di kalender, menyebutkan urutan hari dan bulan, serta mengikuti pergantian minggu, bulan, dan tahun.

#### Membaca jam

Skills: 5

[clock.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/clock/clock.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Matching clock-hand positions and digital notation to a particular instant of the day at different levels of reading precision.

##### Membaca waktu dalam format 24 jam

[read24HourClock.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/clock/skills/read24HourClock.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** The 24-hour format identifies the hour within a day without AM or PM; 00:00 denotes the start of the day and 12:00 denotes noon. Clock time must be distinguished from duration, and conventions for expressing the end of a day must be considered.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membaca waktu 24 jam, memahami bahwa 00.00 mengawali hari dan 12.00 adalah tengah hari, tanpa mencampur waktu tertentu dengan durasi.

##### Membaca waktu hingga ketelitian lima menit

[readFiveMinute.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/clock/skills/readFiveMinute.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Each numbered hour interval on a standard twelve-hour clock face represents five minutes. Reading the time combines the minute scale with the hour hand's position, without confusing an hour numeral with a minute count.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membaca waktu setiap kelipatan lima menit dengan menghitung tanda jarum menit dan memeriksa posisi jarum jam.

##### Membaca waktu setengah jam dan seperempat jam

[readHalfQuarter.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/clock/skills/readHalfQuarter.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Half an hour is 30 minutes and a quarter of an hour is 15 minutes. On an analog clock, the minute hand indicates the fraction of the hour while the hour hand advances toward the next hour.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membaca setengah jam dan seperempat jam, mengetahui bahwa keduanya 30 dan 15 menit serta jarum jam bergerak di antara angka.

##### Membaca waktu tepat pada jam

[readHour.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/clock/skills/readHour.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Analog and digital clocks represent the same instant differently. Reading the hour requires interpreting both clock hands and relating their positions to digital notation; the hour hand moves continuously rather than jumping between hour marks.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membaca waktu tepat pada jam analog atau digital dengan memahami jarum jam dan jarum menit dengan benar.

##### Membaca dan menuliskan waktu hingga ketelitian satu menit

[readMinute.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/clock/skills/readMinute.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A clock divides an hour into 60 equal minutes; digital notation combines the hour number with minutes elapsed since its start. The competency includes two-digit minute notation and distinguishing an instant from an elapsed interval.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa membaca dan menulis waktu hingga menit terdekat dengan 60 tanda menit dan dua digit menit pada jam digital.

#### Durasi

Skills: 4

[duration.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/duration/duration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Relationships among seconds, minutes, and hours, and deriving a time interval or instant from other known time information.

##### Mengonversi jam dan menit

[convertHoursMinutes.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/duration/skills/convertHoursMinutes.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Hours and minutes are duration units related exactly by 1 hour = 60 minutes. Conversion must preserve the same elapsed duration irrespective of its numerical representation.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa mengubah jam menjadi menit dan menit menjadi jam, mengetahui satu jam tepat 60 menit dan lamanya waktu tetap sama.

##### Mengonversi menit dan detik

[convertMinutesSeconds.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/duration/skills/convertMinutesSeconds.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Minutes and seconds are duration units related exactly by 1 minute = 60 seconds. Conversion preserves the physical interval; a second hand's current reading is not the total elapsed seconds of a long event.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa mengubah menit menjadi detik dan detik menjadi menit, mengetahui satu menit tepat 60 detik dan lamanya waktu tetap sama.

##### Menghitung waktu yang berlalu

[eventDuration.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/duration/skills/eventDuration.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** Duration is the interval between an event's start and finish, not either individual clock reading. It is found by consistently subtracting time instants and, where needed, accounting for hour, day, or calendar boundaries.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menghitung berapa lama kegiatan berlangsung dari waktu mulai dan selesai, termasuk saat melewati pergantian jam atau tengah malam.

##### Menentukan waktu mulai atau selesai dari durasi

[findStartOrEnd.data.ts](../../../learningApps/math/data/skills/time/duration/skills/findStartOrEnd.data.ts)

**Methodological description (English):** A known instant and a duration determine the other instant by adding or subtracting a time interval. Hour, day, and date rollovers must be handled without confusing clock-time notation with duration units.

**User-friendly description (id):** Kamu bisa menentukan waktu mulai atau selesai suatu kegiatan jika durasi dan waktu lainnya diketahui, termasuk saat tanggal berganti.
